# Work Item forms

GitHub Issue forms create the Work Items described in
[`Project/policies/work-items.md`](../../Project/policies/work-items.md).
The `type:*` labels are project conventions; create matching repository
labels if GitHub does not already have them.

## Version history

| Version | Date | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 0.1.0 | 2026-11-12 | Initial Research, Experiment, Task, Finding, Change Request, and Risk forms. |
